description: Frontend (in-place, live frontend dir): add a thin client-local SessionStore persisting ONLY firebaseUid/email/role (never password/token) as a startup HINT / display aid, written on login/verify-success and cleared on logout; and fix the trainer-provider leakage so Trainer A's students/Trainer Code cannot surface for a later-logged-in User B. This is isolated to the session/auth/logout surface and is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (it touches different files, except for adding invalidation calls in the two logout paths). Must NOT change routing authority: the go_router redirect keeps using Firebase session + backend /api/auth/verify as the gates and role source; no new async gates; local role never overrides backend role; no Firestore write on reopen.
steps: Create lib/core/session/session_store.dart: a thin class backed by the existing sharedPreferencesProvider that persists ONLY firebaseUid, email, role (NEVER password/token), with save({uid,email,role}), read(), and clear(). Expose a sessionStoreProvider. Confirm sharedPreferencesProvider's exact location/name before wiring (it is overridden in lib/main.dart).

Write the SessionStore on the verify/login success path: in the account/verify success site (confirm the exact provider — e.g. the accountInfoProvider success path in the auth account provider, and/or authController.login) call sessionStore.save with the backend-verified uid/email/role. HARD CONSTRAINTS: hint/display only; do NOT add any new async gate to the go_router redirect in lib/core/routing/app_router.dart; the router MUST keep routing by backend account.role; local role must NEVER override backend role (preserve the hardened reopen/redirect race fix); introduce NO Firestore write on reopen (SharedPreferences only).

On logout clear the SessionStore (call sessionStore.clear()) in addition to the existing Firebase signOut(). Apply to BOTH logout paths: student lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart _confirmLogout and trainer lib/features/trainer/presentation/trainer_profile_screen.dart logout, routed through authController.logout / auth_repository.logout.

Fix trainer-provider leakage: on logout explicitly ref.invalidate the trainer provider tree (trainerProfileProvider, trainerStudentsProvider, trainerRequestsProvider if present, the student*Provider families, myTrainerProvider, trainerReferralCodeProvider, trainerTabProvider) — OR scope them to the signed-in uid — so cached Trainer A data cannot be read by a subsequently-logged-in User B. Implement in both logout paths (or a shared logout routine they both call).

Tests (lockstep): extend test/trainer_routing_test.dart with a logout-no-leak case (Trainer A logout -> User B login shows no Trainer A students/Trainer Code). Add/adjust a SessionStore-focused test if practical. Keep test/auth_restore_test.dart, test/auth_repository_test.dart, test/auth_error_mapper_test.dart GREEN (reopen invariant intact; no routing regression).
acceptance_criteria: A SessionStore persists only firebaseUid/email/role to SharedPreferences on successful login/verify and clears them on logout; no password or token is ever stored.

The go_router redirect is unchanged in authority: routing is driven by Firebase session + backend /api/auth/verify role; no new async gate is added and local role never overrides backend role; reopen performs no Firestore write.
After Trainer A logs out and User B logs in, none of Trainer A's students, Trainer Code, or trainer profile data is visible to User B (trainer providers invalidated/scoped on both logout paths).
flutter analyze is clean; auth_restore/auth_repository tests stay green and the trainer_routing_test logout-no-leak case passes.
verification: flutter test   (all suites pass, incl. the logout-no-leak case in trainer_routing_test.dart and the unchanged auth_restore/auth_repository suites)
findings: Implemented on branch feat/trainer-role-session-fix (frontend live dir), commit b73a0c9. Files: NEW lib/core/session/session_store.dart (SessionStore + SessionSnapshot + sessionStoreProvider, backed by the existing sharedPreferencesProvider overridden in main.dart; persists ONLY firebaseUid/email/role via keys session.firebaseUid/email/role — never password/token; save/read/clear). WRITE on success: accountInfoProvider's onSuccess fire-and-forgets sessionStore.save(uid/email/role) with the backend-verified AccountInfo (unawaited, dart:async import added) — hint/display only. LOGOUT teardown: AuthController now takes Ref; logout() clears the SessionStore then invalidates the whole trainer provider tree (trainerProfileProvider, trainerStudentsProvider, trainerRequestsProvider, trainerReferralCodeProvider, trainerTabProvider, myTrainerProvider, and the student*Provider families: overview/workouts/workoutHistory/nutrition/water/progress/photos) before Firebase signOut. Both logout paths route through authController.logout: trainer_profile_screen already did; profile_screen _confirmLogout switched from authRepositoryProvider.logout() to authControllerProvider.notifier.logout() (removed now-unused messenger local, added auth_controller import). HARD CONSTRAINTS honored: app_router.dart UNCHANGED — no new async gate; routing still driven by Firebase session + backend /api/auth/verify role; local role never overrides backend role (reopen race fix preserved); no Firestore write on reopen (SharedPreferences only). Tests: extended test/trainer_routing_test.dart with 'Logout clears session + no trainer-data leak' group — a _SwitchingTrainerRepo + _FakeLogoutRepo prove that after Trainer A logout the SessionStore is cleared and the trainer providers re-fetch so User B sees no Trainer A students/Trainer Code/profile. Verification: flutter analyze clean (No issues found); flutter test green (126 tests, incl. new case; auth_restore/auth_repository/auth_error_mapper unchanged and passing).
